title: NZ MBIE Determination 2026/005 (comparative): 2016 s72 consent, inundation, work since substantially completed
jurisdiction: New Zealand (Building Act 2004); Christchurch City Council; comparative only, not Alberta

facts.text: The authority granted building consent BC/2016/7401 under section 72, with a section 73 natural-hazard notice for inundation.
The owners applied for building consent on 30 August 2016 for a new two-level dwelling with attached garage.
The design included foundation stabilisation and ground improvements and increased site levels around the dwelling.
The building work proceeded and was substantially completed.
The property is a 677m² section on the banks of the Wairarapa Stream.
